words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: The beggar sat on the street with a cup.
words.ex_cn: 那个乞丐坐在街上，手里拿着一个杯子。
words.en: A beggar is a person who lives by asking people for money or food.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: His decisive action saved the team.
words.ex_cn: 他果断的行动拯救了团队。
words.en: If a fact, action, or event is decisive, it makes it certain that there will be a particular result.

words.ex: He tried to smuggle cigarettes across the border.
words.ex_cn: 他试图走私香烟过境。
words.en: To smuggle goods or people means to move them into or out of a country illegally.

words.ex: The lad is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A lad is a young man or boy.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.ex: He joined the navy after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他高中毕业后加入了海军。
words.en: The navy is the part of a country's armed forces that is trained to operate at sea.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.ex: I am awaiting the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我正在等公交车。
words.en: If you await someone or something, you wait for them.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: He scarcely ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃任何东西。
words.en: You use scarcely to emphasize that something is only just true or only just the case.

words.tr: adj. 随之发生的；作为结果的；
words.ex: The rain was heavy, and the flood was consequent.
words.ex_cn: 雨下得很大，洪水随之发生。
words.en: Following as a result or effect.

words.tr:
n. 绝望；
v. 绝望；
words.ex: He felt despair after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到绝望。
words.en: Despair is the feeling that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.tr: adj. 严厉的；严峻的；冷酷无情的；坚定的；可怕的
words.ex: He had a grim look on his face.
words.ex_cn: 他脸上带着严峻的表情。
words.en: If a situation or piece of news is grim, it is very serious, unpleasant, and depressing.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.ex: He felt ashamed for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对妈妈撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: If someone is ashamed, they feel embarrassed or guilty because of something they have done or because of their appearance.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: The stone skimmed over the water.
words.ex_cn: 石头掠过水面。
words.en: To remove a substance from the surface of a liquid, or to read or consider something quickly in order to understand the main points, without studying it in detail.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: He prays every morning before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃早餐前祈祷。
words.en: To pray means to speak to God in order to give thanks or to ask for something.

words.ex: Can you summarise the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarise something, you give a summary of it.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.ex: She has a slender figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: Someone or something that is slender is thin and graceful.

words.ex: The long meeting was tedious.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很沉闷。
words.en: If you describe something such as a job, task, or situation as tedious, you mean it is boring and rather frustrating.

words.ex: He is pessimistic about the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持悲观态度。
words.en: If someone is pessimistic, they expect that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.tr:
n. 轻拍；
v. 轻拍；
words.ex: He gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻拍了拍狗的头。
words.en: To gently touch someone or something with your hand flat.

words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If something is applicable to a particular situation, it is relevant or suitable for that situation.

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.ex: He shivered in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 他在寒风中哆嗦。
words.en: If you shiver, your body shakes slightly because you are cold or frightened.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: He works on a naval ship.
words.ex_cn: 他在一艘军舰上工作。
words.en: Naval means relating to the navy, especially to ships that are used in war.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.ex: She put the kettle on to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她把水壶放在炉子上烧水泡茶。
words.en: A kettle is a container or device in which water is boiled, having a lid, spout, and handle, used for making tea or coffee.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.tr:
n. 刺；刺痛；
v. 刺；刺痛；
words.ex: The bee gave him a sharp sting.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给了他一下刺痛。
words.en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, it pricks your skin and usually pushes poison into your body with a sharp pointed part of its body.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: He apologizes for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而道歉。
words.en: To express regret for something that one has done wrong.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: He hurt his rib when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了肋骨。
words.en: A rib is one of the long curved bones that are connected to the spine and surround the chest.

words.ex: He used the word negro to describe the man, which made everyone uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他用‘黑人’这个词来描述那个男人，这让所有人都感到不舒服。
words.en: A term for a person of African descent, now considered offensive in most contexts.

words.ex: The stars seem eternal in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中的星星看起来是永久的。
words.en: If something is eternal, it lasts forever.

words.ex: The workman fixed the roof with tools.
words.ex_cn: 工人用工具修好了屋顶。
words.en: A workman is a man who works with his hands, especially in a skilled job.

words.ex: The old bike has rust on its chain.
words.ex_cn: 这辆旧自行车的链条上有锈。
words.en: Rust is a reddish-brown substance that forms on the surface of iron or steel when they are exposed to air and moisture, causing them to corrode.

words.ex: He kneel to pray every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跪下祈祷。
words.en: To kneel means to go down into a position where one or both knees are on the ground.

words.tr:
n. 小伙子；家伙
v. 皲裂
words.ex: The chap helped me carry the boxes.
words.ex_cn: 那个小伙子帮我搬了箱子。
words.en: A chap is a man or boy. If something chaps your skin, it makes it sore and cracked.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.ex: The teacher reenforced the rules to keep the class quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师加强了规则以保持课堂安静。
words.en: To strengthen or support, especially by additional material or personnel.

words.tr: adj. 不感兴趣的；不关心的；
words.ex: He was indifferent to the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影不感兴趣。
words.en: If you accuse someone of being indifferent to something, you mean that they have a complete lack of interest in it.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: The porter carried his bags to the taxi.
words.ex_cn: 行李搬运工把他的行李搬到了出租车上。
words.en: A porter is a person whose job is to carry things, especially travelers' luggage at places such as railway stations or hotels.

words.tr:
v. 举起；投掷；起伏；喘息；呕吐
n. 举；投；掷；起伏
words.ex: He heave the box onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子举到了桌子上。
words.en: To lift or haul something heavy with great effort; to throw something forcefully; to rise and fall rhythmically or with effort.

words.tr: v. 公开承认；宣布；声称
words.ex: He professes to love music.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己热爱音乐。
words.en: If you profess to do or have something, you claim that you do it or have it.

words.ex: They cooperate to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作以按时完成项目。
words.en: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: There is a connexion between rain and wet streets.
words.ex_cn: 雨和湿漉漉的街道之间有联系。
words.en: A connexion is a relationship between two or more things, people, or groups.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.ex: He drank coffee from a large mug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个大杯子里喝咖啡。
words.en: A mug is a large, deep cup with straight sides and a handle, used for hot drinks. It can also refer to someone's face or a foolish person. As a verb, it means to attack and rob someone violently in a public place.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.ex: The devil made him do it.
words.ex_cn: 魔鬼让他这么做的。
words.en: In Christian theology, the devil is the supreme spirit of evil, often represented as the tempter of humankind and the enemy of God and goodness.

words.ex: He uses optical lenses to see small objects.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光学镜片来看小物体。
words.en: Relating to sight, especially in relation to the physical action of light.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

words.ex: The leaves fell downwards.
words.ex_cn: 树叶往下落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.ex: He finally conceded defeat after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他终于承认失败了。
words.en: If you concede something, you admit, often unwillingly, that it is true or correct.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.ex: She scissored the paper into two pieces.
words.ex_cn: 她把纸剪成了两半。
words.en: To cut something with scissors.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息
n. 气喘；喘息
words.ex: He panted after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: To breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.tr:
n. 律师；劝告
v. 提供咨询；劝告
words.ex: He hired a counsel to defend him in court.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名律师为他在法庭上辩护。
words.en: Counsel refers to the act of giving advice or guidance, especially in a legal context, or to the person who provides such advice.

words.ex: He withdrew $100 from the ATM.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机里提取了100美元。
words.en: If you withdraw something from a place, you remove it or take it away.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.ex: He bought a packet of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一小包糖。
words.en: A packet is a small container in which a quantity of something is sold. Packets are either small boxes made of thin cardboard, or bags or envelopes made of paper or plastic.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: The map has an indicative arrow to show the way.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图上有一个指示方向的箭头。
words.en: If one thing is indicative of another, it suggests what the other thing is likely to be.

words.tr:
v. 安慰；慰问
n. 控制台；操纵台
words.ex: She whispered kind words to console her crying friend.
words.ex_cn: 她轻声说些安慰的话来安抚哭泣的朋友。
words.en: If you console someone who is unhappy about something, you try to make them feel more cheerful.

words.ex: He felt hatred for the man who hurt his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他憎恨那个伤害他兄弟的人。
words.en: Hatred is an extremely strong feeling of dislike for someone or something.

words.ex: He gave her a light pinch on the arm.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻捏了她的胳膊一下。
words.en: To pinch someone or something means to squeeze them tightly between your thumb and finger, or between two surfaces, especially in a way that causes pain.

words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.ex: He tries to memorize the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天试着记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorize something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.ex: She carries a red handbag to work.
words.ex_cn: 她带着一个红色的手提包去上班。
words.en: A handbag is a small bag used by women to carry personal items.

words.ex: The view from the hill is marvellous.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色绝妙极了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as marvellous, you are emphasizing that they are extremely good, enjoyable, or impressive.

words.tr: adj. 壮观的；辉煌的；极好的；
words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was splendid.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落非常壮观。
words.en: If you say that something is splendid, you mean that it is very good.

words.tr: adj. 令人烦恼的；讨厌的；
words.ex: The noisy neighbors are troublesome.
words.ex_cn: 那些吵闹的邻居令人烦恼。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as troublesome, you mean that they cause you a lot of problems or worries.

words.ex: The cumulative score is the total of all previous points.
words.ex_cn: 累积得分是所有之前分数的总和。
words.en: If a series of events have a cumulative effect, each event makes the effect greater.

words.tr: adj. 可容许的；可承认的
words.ex: It is permissible to use a calculator in this test.
words.ex_cn: 在这次考试中使用计算器是允许的。
words.en: If something is permissible, it is considered to be acceptable because it does not break any laws or rules.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: The sailors cleaned the stern of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们打扫了船尾。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as stern, you mean that they are severe or strict.

words.ex: The ship sailed inward toward the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船向港口内航行。
words.en: Directed or moving towards the inside; relating to the inside or inner part of something.

words.ex: He is impatient when he waits for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时很不耐烦。
words.en: If you are impatient, you are easily annoyed by delays or by people making mistakes.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.tr:
n. 耸肩
v. 耸肩
words.ex: He shrugged when asked why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到为什么迟到时，他耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you shrug, you raise your shoulders to show that you are not interested in something or that you do not know or care about something.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.ex: The fence will inclose the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏将围绕花园。
words.en: To surround or close off on all sides; to include along with something else in a parcel or envelope.

words.tr: n. 四轮货车；敞篷货车
words.ex: The horse pulled a wooden waggon.
words.ex_cn: 马拉着一辆木制马车。
words.en: A waggon is a large vehicle that is pulled by horses or oxen and is used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.ex: They will liberate the prisoners tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天会释放这些囚犯。
words.en: To liberate a place or the people in it means to free them from the political or military control of another country, area, or group of people.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.ex: He will sue the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 他将起诉这家公司要求赔偿。
words.en: To sue means to start a legal case against someone, usually to claim money from them because they have caused you harm or loss.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.tr: adj. 复数的； n. 复数；
words.ex: The word 'cats' is a plural form.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cats' 是复数形式。
words.en: The plural form of a word is the form that is used when referring to more than one person or thing.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: At the outset, he was unsure about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 在开始时，他对这个计划并不确定。
words.en: The outset of something is the beginning of it.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.ex: The crane lifted the heavy steel beam.
words.ex_cn: 起重机吊起了沉重的钢梁。
words.en: A crane is a large machine that moves heavy things by lifting them in the air. It is also a large bird with long legs and a long neck.

words.ex: The sun wakens the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天早晨唤醒鸟儿。
words.en: to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

words.ex: The soldiers raided the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间突袭了敌人的营地。
words.en: A raid is a sudden attack on a place by soldiers, police, or other officials, in order to search for something or to arrest someone.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.ex: He heard a footstep behind him.
words.ex_cn: 他听到身后有脚步声。
words.en: A footstep is the sound or mark that is made by someone walking each time their foot touches the ground.

words.ex: The civilian population stayed safe during the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 平民在冲突期间保持安全。
words.en: A civilian is a person who is not a member of the military or of a police or firefighting force.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.ex: He left a heap of clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把一堆衣服扔在地上。
words.en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

words.ex: The classroom is orderly and clean.
words.ex_cn: 教室整洁有序。
words.en: If something is done in an orderly fashion or manner, it is done in a well-organized and controlled way.

words.ex: She picked a violet from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵紫罗兰。
words.en: A violet is a small plant that has purple or white flowers in the spring.

words.ex: The country uses metric units for weight and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用米制单位来衡量重量和距离。
words.en: A metric is a system of measurement that uses meters, liters, and grams as its basic units.

words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很勤奋地做作业。
words.en: Someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: The fireman saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从树上救下了那只猫。
words.en: A fireman is a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people from dangerous situations, especially in buildings.

words.ex: They maintain correspondence through letters.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过信件保持通信联系。
words.en: Communication by exchanging letters with someone; a close similarity, connection, or equivalence.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: If something revolves or if you revolve something, it moves or turns around a central point or line.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；落泪
v. 流泪；流出
words.ex: Her weep lasted for hours after the news.
words.ex_cn: 听到消息后，她的哭泣持续了数小时。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.ex: Goodness, I didn't expect to see you here!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我没料到会在这里见到你！
words.en: Goodness is the quality of being kind, helpful, and honest.

words.ex: He is presently working at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他现在在一家银行工作。
words.en: At the present time; now. Or in a short time; soon.

words.ex: The children are merry on Christmas day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节那天很开心。
words.en: If you describe someone's character or behavior as merry, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.ex: Each student received their respective book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都收到了他们各自的书。
words.en: Relating or belonging separately to each of two or more people or things.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.tr: adj. 考虑周到的；体贴的；
words.ex: He is considerate and always asks if others need help.
words.ex_cn: 他很体贴，总是问别人是否需要帮助。
words.en: Someone who is considerate pays attention to the needs, wishes, or feelings of other people.

words.ex: The Magna Carta is an old charter of rights.
words.ex_cn: 《大宪章》是一份古老的权力宪章。
words.en: A charter is a formal document describing the rights, aims, or principles of an organization or group of people.

words.ex: The temple is a divine place.
words.ex_cn: 这座寺庙是神的圣地。
words.en: Something that is divine relates to a god or goddess.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.tr:
n. 疼痛；隐痛；渴望
v. 疼痛；隐痛
words.ex: My head aches after staying up late.
words.ex_cn: 我熬夜后头痛。
words.en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

words.ex: The cost is proportional to the size.
words.ex_cn: 成本与大小成比例。
words.en: If one amount is proportional to another, the two amounts increase and decrease at the same rate so there is always the same relationship between them.

words.ex: This color characterises the style of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这种颜色表现了这位艺术家的风格。
words.en: To describe the distinctive nature or features of something or someone.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小孩在玩球。
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.ex: He said a prayer before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前做了一次祈祷。
words.en: A prayer is a form of religious practice in which people communicate with a deity or spirit, often to ask for help or to give thanks.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr: adj. 一定会；密切相关的；有义务的； v. “bind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is bound to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会赢得比赛。
words.en: If one person, thing, or situation is bound to another, they are closely connected with each other, and it is difficult for them to be separated or to escape from each other. If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.tr: v. 辞职；使…顺从于（做）某事；
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.tr: adj. 有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；
words.ex: He is liable for the damage caused by his car.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的车造成的损害负有责任。
words.en: If you are liable for something such as a debt or a duty, you are legally responsible for it. If something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.tr:
n. 长队；
v. 排队；
words.ex: There is a long queue at the ticket counter.
words.ex_cn: 售票处排着一条长队。
words.en: A queue is a line of people or vehicles waiting for something.

words.ex: The child was restless during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在漫长的会议中坐立不安。
words.en: If you are restless, you are unable to stay still or to be calm and happy, because you are bored or worried.

words.ex: The boy showed defiance by refusing to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 男孩通过拒绝遵守规则来表现违抗。
words.en: Defiance is behaviour or an attitude which shows that you are not willing to obey someone or something.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.tr: v. 符合；“fit”的现在分词； adj. 恰当的；适合的；
words.ex: This shoe fits my foot perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋很合我的脚。
words.en: Appropriate or suitable for a particular purpose, person, occasion, etc.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.tr: adj. 较低的；下游的；“low”的比较级； v. 降低；
words.ex: He sat in the lower row of the theater.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在剧院的较低一排。
words.en: If you lower something, you move it slowly downwards. If you lower something, you make it less in amount, degree, value, or quality.

words.ex: The company advertize its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在电视上为其新手机做广告。
words.en: To advertize means to make something known to the public, especially in order to sell it or promote it.

words.ex: He saw an advertizement for a new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则新手机的广告。
words.en: A notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event (variant spelling of 'advertisement').

words.tr: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: I don't like it, but I'll do it anyhow.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，但我还是会做。
words.en: in whatever way or manner; regardless of how

words.ex: The crowd applauded after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: To applaud means to show approval or praise by clapping the hands.

words.ex: The old barque sailed slowly across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘古老的三桅帆船缓缓驶过大海。
words.en: A barque is a type of sailing ship with three or more masts, having the foremast and mainmast square-rigged and the mizzenmast fore-and-aft rigged.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor with a broom.
words.ex_cn: 她用扫帚扫地。
words.en: A broom is a cleaning tool consisting of usually stiff fibers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. It is thus a variety of brush with a long handle.

words.ex: He lights a cigarette after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后点了一支香烟。
words.en: A cigaret is a small roll of finely cut tobacco for smoking, enclosed in a wrapper of thin paper.

words.ex: The commander gave the order to advance.
words.ex_cn: 指挥官下达了前进的命令。
words.en: A commander is a person in authority, especially in the armed forces, who gives orders and is responsible for the actions of those under their command.

words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.ex: The children play in the courtyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在庭院里玩耍。
words.en: An open area surrounded by buildings or walls, often found in the center of a complex or building.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: The teacher gave a dictation of five sentences.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了一次五句话的听写。
words.en: Dictation is the speaking or reading aloud of words for someone else to write down.

words.ex: The donkey carries water on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这头驴在山上驮水。
words.en: A donkey is a four-legged animal related to the horse, but smaller and with longer ears. Donkeys are often used for carrying or pulling things, especially in parts of the world where there are no cars or trucks.

words.ex: The evidence is doubtful.
words.ex_cn: 这些证据是可疑的。
words.en: If you are doubtful about something, you are uncertain about it or not sure that it is true or possible.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.ex: He said farewell to his friends before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前向朋友们道别。
words.en: Farewell is an expression of good wishes at parting, often used to say goodbye.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.ex: He was sent to gaol for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被关进了监狱。
words.en: A place where criminals are kept as a punishment for their crimes.

words.ex: The apple weighs 150 gramme.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果重150克。
words.en: A gramme is a metric unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

words.ex: He showed gratitude for the help.
words.ex_cn: 他表达了对帮助的感激。
words.en: Gratitude is the feeling of being thankful and appreciative.

words.ex: He buys milk and bread from the grocer.
words.ex_cn: 他从杂货店买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A grocer is a person who sells food and small household goods.

words.ex: He gave a guaranty that the package would arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 他保证包裹会准时到达。
words.en: A guaranty is a formal promise or assurance that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a debt will be paid or a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.ex: The prince is the heir to the throne.
words.ex_cn: 王子是王位的继承人。
words.en: A person legally entitled to inherit property or a title.

words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.ex: The car has 200 horsepower.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有200马力。
words.en: A unit of power equal to 550 foot-pounds per second (about 750 watts), used in measuring the power of engines or motors.

words.ex: The country wants to industrialise to create more jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望工业化以创造更多就业机会。
words.en: To industrialise means to develop industry on a wide scale in a country or region.

words.ex: He pays the debt in monthly instilment.
words.ex_cn: 他按月支付债务。
words.en: The gradual introduction or imparting of knowledge, ideas, or principles.

words.ex: The lavatory is down the hall.
words.ex_cn: 洗手间在走廊尽头。
words.en: A lavatory is a room equipped with a toilet and sink for washing hands and face.

words.ex: He drinks two litres of water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝两升水。
words.en: A litre is a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimetres (or approximately 1.75 pints).

words.ex: They watch TV in the living-room.
words.ex_cn: 他们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A living-room is a room in a house where people sit together, watch television, etc.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.

words.ex: The maid cleans the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女仆每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A maid is a woman who works as a servant in a hotel or in someone's home.

words.ex: The army launched a missile at the target.
words.ex_cn: 军队向目标发射了一枚导弹。
words.en: A missile is a weapon that is sent through the air and that explodes when it hits the thing it is aimed at.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.ex: He writes his homework in a notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业写在笔记本里。
words.en: A notebook is a small book for writing notes in, or a small computer that is easy to carry.

words.ex: He bought a paperback novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本平装小说。
words.en: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover, as opposed to a hardback, which has a hard cover.

words.ex: He drank a pint of beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝了一品脱啤酒。
words.en: A pint is a unit of measurement for liquids. In Britain, it is equal to 568 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon. In the United States, it is equal to 473 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon.

words.ex: The postage for this letter is one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 这封信的邮资是一美元。
words.en: The cost of sending a letter or package by post.

words.ex: He used 'in' as a preposition in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用 'in' 作为介词。
words.en: A preposition is a word such as 'by', 'for', 'into', or 'with' which usually has a noun group as its object.

words.ex: He used 'she' as a pronoun in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用'she'作为代词。
words.en: A pronoun is a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase. Pronouns refer to either a noun that has already been mentioned or to a noun that does not need to be named specifically.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: He wore a rag to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块破布擦地板。
words.en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things. As a verb, to rag means to tease or mock someone persistently.

words.ex: He showed restraint when he stayed calm during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持冷静，表现出了克制。
words.en: Restraint is a measure or condition that keeps someone or something under control or within limits.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.tr:
n. 步枪；来复枪（又称来福枪）
v. 快速搜寻
words.ex: He carries a rifle in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他带着一把步枪在森林里。
words.en: A rifle is a gun with a long barrel which you hold against your shoulder when firing.

words.ex: The loud noise roused him from sleep.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音把他从睡梦中唤醒了。
words.en: If someone rouses you when you are sleeping or if you rouse, you wake up. / To rouse someone means to make them stop doing something and start doing something else.

words.ex: He sat on the rug near the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在壁炉旁的地毯上。
words.en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on the floor to cover part of it and to make it warmer or softer to walk on.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.ex: My mom scolded me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而责备了我。
words.en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.ex: He is a skilful painter who draws beautiful landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有技巧的画家，能画出美丽的风景。
words.en: Someone who is skilful is good at doing something because they have practised it.

words.ex: He believes in socialism and wants equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他相信社会主义，希望所有人都享有平等的权利。
words.en: Socialism is a political and economic theory of social organization which advocates that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.tr:
adj. 社会主义的
n. 社会主义者
words.ex: He is a socialist who believes in equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信平等权利的社会主义者。
words.en: A socialist is someone who believes in socialism, which is a political and economic theory advocating that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: The steamer sailed across the river.
words.ex_cn: 汽船驶过了河。
words.en: A steamer is a ship or boat that is powered by steam engines. It can also refer to a kitchen utensil used for steaming food.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.tr:
v. 弯腰；俯身；卑屈；俯冲
n. 弯腰；屈背；屈服；俯冲
words.ex: He must stoop to enter the small door.
words.ex_cn: 他必须弯腰才能进入那扇小门。
words.en: If someone stoops, they bend their body forwards and downwards.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.tr:
v. 发抖；打颤；战栗；焦虑
n. 震颤；发抖；战栗
words.ex: The old man tremble in the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 老人在寒风中发抖。
words.en: If you tremble, you shake slightly because you are frightened or cold.

words.ex: She is a fast typist.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位打字很快的打字员。
words.en: A typist is someone who types, especially as their job.

words.ex: The car has a flat tyre.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个瘪了的轮胎。
words.en: A tyre is a thick piece of rubber which is fitted onto the wheels of vehicles such as cars, buses, and bicycles in order to make them move smoothly and safely.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.tr:
v. 焊接
n. 焊接
words.ex: He welds metal pieces together with a torch.
words.ex_cn: 他用焊枪把金属片焊接在一起。
words.en: To join pieces of metal together by heating the surfaces until they melt and pressing them together.

words.ex: He waved a red banner in the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面红旗子。
words.en: A banner is a long strip of cloth with a message or design on it, used especially for advertising or as a symbol of a particular group or cause.

words.ex: He is clumsy and dropped the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他很笨拙，把玻璃杯打翻了。
words.en: A clumsy person moves or handles things in a careless, awkward way, often so that things are knocked over or broken.

words.ex: The child lost himself in phantasy about flying dragons.
words.ex_cn: 孩子沉浸在关于会飞的龙的幻想中。
words.en: A phantasy is an idea or belief that is not based on reality, but is imagined or invented.

words.ex: He buys gasolene at the station every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五在加油站买汽油。
words.en: Gasolene is a volatile flammable liquid hydrocarbon mixture used as a fuel especially for internal combustion engines and usually blended from several products of natural gas and petroleum.

words.ex: He tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一些幽默的故事，让大家都笑。
words.en: If you are humorous, you are able to be amusing and to make people laugh.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.ex: He wears a nylon jacket to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件尼龙夹克来保持干燥。
words.en: Nylon is a strong, elastic synthetic fiber used especially in the manufacture of clothing, ropes, and brushes.

words.ex: This temperature is the optimum for growing plants.
words.ex_cn: 这个温度是最适宜植物生长的。
words.en: The optimum is the best or most favorable condition, degree, amount, etc., for achieving a particular result.

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: His refusal to apologize made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝道歉，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: The act of refusing to do something or to accept something.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: I sympathise with people who lose their homes in storms.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些在风暴中失去家园的人。
words.en: To feel or express sympathy; to share or understand the feelings of another.

words.ex: He is a man of great wit.
words.ex_cn: 他是个极具机智的人。
words.en: Wit is the ability to use words or ideas in a quick, clever, and amusing way.

words.tr:
adj. 该死的；可恶的；糟透的
v. 咒骂（某人下地狱）
words.ex: It's a damn good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个该死的好主意。
words.en: If you say that someone is damned if they do something, you mean that they will be in a very difficult situation if they do it.

words.ex: The old toy is worthless now.
words.ex_cn: 这个旧玩具现在毫无价值。
words.en: If something is worthless, it has no use or value.
